title: Aircraft Records Specialist
description:
**Aircraft Records Specialist (Remote, Contract)**



**About Radar**



Radar digitizes and connects aircraft maintenance records. We take scanned paper logbooks, manuals, STCs, and FAA documents and turn them into structured, searchable records, total times and cycles, AD and SB compliance, inspections, life-limited parts, and 8130-3 release tags, all tied to the actual aircraft.



Operators, owners, lenders, and buyers use Radar to query their records, prove compliance, and return aircraft to service faster. Our AI does the first pass on every page. Your job is to make sure it's right.



**The role**



You'll work inside Radar's Logbook Viewer to review, correct, and QA the records our AI extracts from each aircraft's logbooks. We measure work in "tails" — one tail is one aircraft's complete records, and a single tail can run to thousands of scanned pages. Accuracy and consistency matter more than raw speed. For each tail you will:



- **Classify documents -** confirm or correct each document's type and content (Logbook Entry / service record, Authorized Release Certificate / 8130-3, Work Order, 8110, 337, shipping documents, etc) and flag Unclassified or Junk. Clear the Unclassified queue so nothing is left ambiguous.

- **Link and organize pages -** move mis-grouped page sections into the right document; split or merge so each real-world record (e.g. an 8130 tag stapled to a page) is its own clean entry.

- **Attach records to the right aircraft -** verify the tail / N-number and reassign when the AI guessed wrong.

- **Verify extracted data -** check extracted fields against the source image: dates, airframe/engine/APU/propeller total time and cycles (TSN/CSN), part numbers and serials, repair station and signatures.

- **Review and sign off -** mark each document Reviewed, comment on anything ambiguous, and flag documents that can serve as public compliance evidence.



**A typical week**



You process a batch of new logbooks yourself and QA a batch that's ready to ship. You escalate the genuinely ambiguous records instead of guessing, and you help make the next hundred tails go smoother than the last by flagging patterns the AI keeps getting wrong.



**What we're looking for**



- **Aviation records familiarity -** you can look at a logbook entry, an 8130-3, or a work order and know what it is and what matters on it. Fits: A&P mechanic, aircraft records clerk, Director of Maintenance, Part 145 repair-station records, or back-to-birth records research. A current certificate is a plus, not a requirement.

- **Meticulous and consistent -** you notice a tail number off by a digit, and apply the same rules on page 8,000 as on page 1.

- **Strong written English -** you'll read US/FAA documents and write clear review comments.

- **Comfortable in web software -** you'll live in a browser-based review tool all day.

- **Reliable and communicative -** you own a queue and a turnaround time, and you flag slippage early. This matters to us more than anything else here.

- **~4+ hours daily overlap with US business hours (ET).**



**Nice to have**



ADs, Service Bulletins, ATA chapters, life-limited parts, Form 337, or pre-buy / back-to-birth records research. Experience QAing others' work or writing SOPs — we're early and small, and the right person can help shape how records get processed and checked.



**Logistics**



- Contract, paid monthly. Remote - with US ET overlap preferred for timezone.

- ~Full-time, flexible, with daily US overlap. Part-time considered for strong aviation-domain candidates.

- Compensation: ~$1,000/month is our benchmark for an experienced records person.

- Start immediately. Long-term role; strong performers can grow into a lead/QA position that owns training and SOPs.



**How we hire**



1) Short application + a few questions on your aviation-records background. 2) A brief call. 3) A paid trial on one real tail — you'll classify, link, and QA a sample of pages in Radar so we both see how the work feels. Reliability and accuracy on the real tool matter more to us than a resume.



To apply: reply here with a short note on your aviation-records experience and your availability in US-ET hours.

title: Operations VA - Short-Term Rental - Fixed UK Morning Shift
description:
Operations Virtual Assistant - Short-Term Rental (Remote, UK Hours)



Company: Higgihaus Aparthotels

Location: Remote (Philippines based, working UK hours)

Hours: Full-time, 5 days a week, fixed shift: Friday to Tuesday, 7:00am to 3:00pm UK time (Sunday is a working day and is non-negotiable)

Pay: $3.50 - $4.00 per hour, depending on experience



ABOUT US



Higgihaus runs a portfolio of aparthotels across Bristol and Cardiff in the UK. We have spent seven years building an operation that runs on tight systems, good data, and a small team that trusts each other. We are not a giant call centre and we never will be. We are a lean operations team that takes guest experience and operational quality seriously.



You would be joining our remote operations team, working alongside our existing operations VA on the evening shift, with a daily overlap hour for handover and team connection. You will be trained directly by the founder and supported as you find your feet. This is a genuine team, not a set of people who only ever clock on when someone else clocks off.



THE ROLE



This is a front-line guest operations role at its core. Your main job is to deliver brilliant, responsive guest communications and keep the operation running smoothly across your morning shift. Much of our routine guest messaging is already handled by automation, so this is not a high-volume copy-paste job. It is about handling the situations that need a real person: judgement calls, live problems during a guest's stay, escalations, the occasional phone call, and keeping guests happy when things do not go to plan.



You need to be a genuinely good communicator. Warm, clear, calm under pressure. That part is non-negotiable because it is the heart of the job.



Beyond comms, we want a systems brain. Our operation runs on Hostaway, Airtable, PriceLabs and a stack of automations. You do not need to be a developer, but you do need to be the kind of person who asks why a problem keeps happening and fixes the cause, not just the symptom. For the right person there is a clear growth path into revenue management, data and automation work over time.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own guest communications across your shift: enquiries, in-stay issues, escalations from our AI comms system

- Handle live operational problems: lockouts, cleaning issues, maintenance coordination with our UK team

- Take the occasional guest phone call in clear, confident English

- Monitor and action the daily operations picture: arrivals, departures, flags from our automated reports

- Keep our systems accurate: Hostaway, Airtable records, task tracking

- Spot recurring problems and raise them with the fix, not just the complaint



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Direct short-term rental / Airbnb industry experience

- Impeccable written English and confident spoken English on the phone

- Comfortable and reliable on the fixed Friday to Tuesday, 7am to 3pm UK shift, every week, including Sunday

- Strong tech proficiency: quick to learn new software, comfortable with AI tools

- Experience with a PMS (Hostaway ideal), Airtable or Asana, and ideally PriceLabs or Wheelhouse

- A root-cause mindset: you dig into why a problem keeps happening

- Reliable home setup: fast internet and a backup plan for power or connection outages

- Full-time and exclusive: no other employers alongside this role



WHAT YOU GET



- A stable, long-term full-time role with a team that has operated for seven years

- Trained directly by the founder, with real investment in your development

- A fixed shift, so your body clock and your life outside work stay predictable

- Genuine growth path into revenue management, data and automation for the right person

- A team culture built on trust and directness, not micromanagement



HOW TO APPLY



Applications are only accepted through our application form.



To receive the form link, reply to this job post with the single word: HIGGIHAUS



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed. Complete every question on the form honestly. We read every submission.

title: Senior Shopify Tracking & Measurement Specialist (GA4 / GTM / Server-side GTM / Stape)
description:

If you prefer structured investigation over guesswork, we'd love to hear from you.

Over the past several weeks, we have conducted multiple phases of investigation into our analytics and tracking environment.



Rather than immediately making production changes, we are looking for an experienced specialist who can independently review our findings, validate the evidence, identify blind spots, and provide an objective technical assessment.



The strongest applicants will be invited to review our complete investigation package during the second round of the hiring process.



Technical Environment



Our Shopify ecosystem currently includes:



Shopify

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Tag Manager (Web)

Server-side Google Tag Manager (Stape)

Shopify Customer Events

Google Ads

Google Merchant Center

Meta Pixel

Pinterest

Connected Site Tags



Experience working with similar tracking architectures is highly preferred.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



Has strong experience with Shopify tracking implementations.

Has advanced knowledge of GA4, GTM, and Server-side GTM.

Can investigate technical issues instead of making assumptions.

Understands measurement architecture and tracking validation.

Can clearly explain technical findings and recommendations.

Enjoys solving challenging technical problems.

Hiring Process

Round 1



Application review.



Round 2



Selected applicants will receive our investigation package and complete a technical review based on a real client project.



Final Round



The strongest candidate will be introduced directly to the store owner for final project discussion.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1.



Tell us about your experience with:



Shopify

GA4

Google Tag Manager

Server-side GTM

Stape

2.



Describe one of the most technically challenging tracking or measurement problems you've solved.



Please explain:



What was the issue?

How did you investigate it?

What was the root cause?

How was it resolved?

3.



Which of the following platforms have you worked with?



Shopify Customer Events

Google Merchant Center

Google Ads Conversion Tracking

Meta Pixel

Pinterest Tracking

Connected Site Tags

4.



What would be your first steps before making any production tracking changes on an existing Shopify store?



5.



Please include your proposed fixed project fee for the initial investigation phase together with your estimated timeline.



Attention to Detail



This project requires careful investigation and strong attention to detail.



To confirm that you've read this job description carefully, please begin your application with the word: Meteorite.



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



Final Note



We are looking for someone who values evidence over assumptions and enjoys solving complex technical challenges through structured investigation.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Phone-Based Appointment Setter / SDR – US Home Care Clients (GoHighLevel)
description:
ABOUT US


 is a US-based growth agency that helps home care agencies get more clients through
 advertising. Our clients provide in-home care to elderly and disabled individuals across the United States. We're a small, fast-moving team hiring our first dedicated Appointment Setter / SDR.



THE ROLE

You will call
 leads within 5 minutes of them filling out a form asking about home care services. On that call, you will build trust, pre-qualify their needs, and book them directly for a free in-home consultation with our client's care team.

This is not a handoff role. You qualify AND book the appointment in one call. The funnel you own:

New Lead ? You Call & Qualify ? You Book the In-Home Assessment ? Assessment Happens



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY



Call every new lead within 5 minutes of form submission (triple-dial on first attempt)

Pre-qualify prospects using our BANT framework (care needs, timeline, decision-maker, service area)

Book in-home consultations directly into the agency's calendar in GoHighLevel while on the phone

Handle objections: "I don't want someone in my house," "Just send me info," "How much does it cost?"

Follow up relentlessly: up to 7 dials on Day 1, morning and evening calls for 14 days, strategic texts and voice notes

Log every call in GoHighLevel with notes, tags, and correct pipeline stage

Send personalized voice notes and texts between call blocks

Ask if the family decision-maker can be present at the home visit (increases close rate)



WHAT YOU ARE NOT DOING



No cold calling — every lead already filled out a form asking for help

No closing or discussing pricing — the care specialist handles that at the home visit

No Medicaid paperwork — for Medicaid leads, you pre-qualify and schedule into the intake coordinator's calendar

No admin, data entry, social media, or tasks outside of calling and scheduling



DAILY TARGETS



50-80 outbound call attempts

15-20 live conversations

7-10 in-home assessments booked

100% of new leads called within 5 minutes

Every call logged in GHL with notes



COMPENSATION



Base: $10/hour + bonuses + incentives 



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS (Non-Negotiable)



Near-native English fluency with a neutral or American accent. You will be calling elderly Americans and their worried adult children. Any noticeable accent will break trust immediately.



1+ year of phone-based SDR, appointment setting, or outbound sales experience. You must be comfortable calling strangers, handling rejection, and following a script while sounding natural.



Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL). You must already know how to navigate contacts, update pipeline stages, use the calendar/booking system, send texts, and manage tags. We will not train you on GHL basics.



Reliable internet (minimum 25 Mbps) and a completely quiet workspace. No background noise during calls. Your environment must sound professional.



Available for US Central Time business hours: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM CST, Mon

day through Friday.



Genuine empathy and patience. You are calling someone's grandmother or someone's stressed-out daughter. If you can't slow down, listen, and make people feel safe, this role is not for you.



Comfortable booking in-home visits, not just phone calls. You're scheduling a real person to enter someone's home. You must be able to position this as safe, free, and no-obligation.



NICE-TO-HAVE (Strong Preference)



Background in healthcare, home care, or senior services

Experience responding to
 lead ads or warm inbound leads

Background as a licensed English teacher or call center trainer

Experience sending personalized voice notes as part of a follow-up cadence

Familiarity with US geography and culture



TOOLS YOU'LL USE



GoHighLevel (GHL) — CRM, dialer, texting, pipeline, calendar booking

Google Workspace — Calendar, Sheets, Docs

Loom — Call recording and coaching reviews

Slack or WhatsApp — Team communication



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Every lead is warm (they asked for help, you're not cold calling)

You own the full outcome from first call to booked appointment

Full training provided: call scripts, objection guides, follow-up cadences

Your earnings grow as we add clients



Path to team lead as we scale and hire additional SDRs



1-WEEK PAID TRIAL



All new hires start with a 1-week paid trial at full base rate ($5/hr x 40 hrs = $200). You'll complete training, practice calls, and start making live calls under coaching. At the end of the week, we both d
 if it's a fit.



HOW TO APPLY

Your application MUST include all four of the following or it will not be reviewed:



1. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English. Tell us your name, where you're from, your SDR experience, and why you want this role. Use Loom, Vocaroo, or a voice memo and include the link. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VOICE RECORDING WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



2. Your GHL experience in detail. What did you use it for? Which features (pipelines, calendars, workflows, dialer, texting)? How many months? Rate yourself 1-10.



3. Your previous SDR or appointment setting results. How many calls per day? Appointment set rate? What industry? How long in the role?



4. Your availability and workspace. What US hours can you work? Describe your workspace. What is your internet speed?



We review applications within 48 hours. Qualified candidates receive a 15-minute phone screen including a live mock objection scenario.

Remote – Must be available during Atlantic Time working hours (e.g., 9am–1pm AT, Monday to Friday)



Why this role is a real opportunity



This is a long-term position with a growing Canadian healthcare company. The right person will have direct access to leadership, genuine ownership of the brand's digital voice, and a clear path to full-time hours as Prescare scales. We pay based on what you bring, not a fixed ceiling.



Be clear-eyed about what you're walking into



Prescare's social media is in early stages — a small following and very few posts so far. This isn't a role to manage an existing presence. It's a role to build one from the ground up for a business that's growing fast. If building something from scratch excites you, this is the right role.



Who we are



Prescare Nursing & Healthcare Staffing is a trusted provider of culturally respectful and client-focused nursing services in the Canadian provinces of Manitoba and New Brunswick. We currently support long-term care facilities and hospitals in Manitoba and are expanding into homecare services in New Brunswick and Winnipeg. In the home care aspect of the company, we serve families, seniors, and healthcare organizations across Manitoba and New Brunswick.



We provide three core services:



Home care — supporting seniors, individuals with disabilities, post-surgery recovery patients, new mothers, and palliative care families in both provinces

Healthcare staffing — placing nurses (RNs, RPNs, LPNs), and healthcare aides (HCAs) with hospitals and long-term care facilities in Manitoba

Residential cleaning — professional home cleaning services across Manitoba and New Brunswick

We are owner-operated, people-first, and known for being responsive, professional, and genuinely caring toward both clients and staff. As we grow, our mission remains the same: to provide dignified, family-centred care to those who need it most. We’re now looking for a creative, reliable, and tech-savvy Digital Marketing & Social Media Lead — Healthcare & Home Care to support our sales and marketing efforts while amplifying our presence across digital platforms.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



The core challenge: two audiences, one brand



This is the most important thing to understand about this role. Prescare's content must speak to two very different groups at the same time:



Families & clients — seniors, adult children arranging care for a parent, new mothers, individuals navigating illness or disability. They need warmth, clarity, and trust — not sales language.



Healthcare professionals — nurses and healthcare aides in Manitoba evaluating staffing agencies. They need to see professionalism, reliability, and a team that respects their work.



The ability to write and create content that speaks authentically to both without confusing either  is one of the most important skills for this role.



What you'll own



Social media management



Build and manage Prescare's
, Instagram, and LinkedIn from a low base to consistent, trusted accounts

Create and execute a monthly content calendar covering all three service lines

Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and inquiries and escalating appropriately

Analyze metrics and submit weekly reports on engagement, reach and lead generation

Collaborate on paid ad campaigns (Meta, Google) and support creative development

 

Content creation



Design graphics, reels, carousels, and branded posts using Canva and CapCut aimed at attracting homecare clients

Create service-specific content for each of the three service lines, each with its own audience and tone

Develop caregiver spotlights, family stories, educational posts, and seasonal/community content

Balance AI-assisted efficiency with warm, human messaging

Google Business & reputation



Maintain and update both Google Business Profiles (Manitoba and New Brunswick separately)

Run Google review and testimonial campaigns to build online credibility

Gather and showcase real client stories within confidentiality guidelines

GoHighLevel & reporting



Support basic
 and SMS campaign content as well as follow-up in GoHighLevel

Assist in generating, qualifying and tracking inbound leads

Deliver a clear weekly report covering posts, engagement, follower growth, review activity, lead signals, and your own recommendations

Optimization & Innovation



Recommend templates, tools, and processes to improve marketing efficiency and sales conversion

Proactively identify opportunities to increase visibility and improve brand messaging

Working with us



Communication via
 and messaging tools during Atlantic or Central Canadian business hours

Weekly check-in with leadership — direct access, no layers of management

You'll submit a weekly report and content calendar for review; beyond that, you'll largely run your own schedule

We value reliability and proactive communication over rigid hours

All client, family, and staff information is strictly confidential - never shared publicly without written approval

What we're looking for



Required:



Social media and digital content management experience for service-based business or start-up (experience in Canadian market is a plus).

Reels and short-form video creation

solid design and editing skills using tools like Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Creative Suite Good understanding of
, Instagram, Canva, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile

Ability to build and follow a monthly content calendar

Independent, reliable, deadline-driven work style, with comfort in managing multiple priorities.

Excellent written English with warmth and cultural sensitivity

Ability to communicate professionally with internal teams and clients

Sensitivity and good judgment around healthcare and senior care content

Strong assets (not required):



Experience with GoHighLevel

Healthcare, home care, or senior care sector experience

Familiarity with Canadian audiences


 or SMS marketing experience

Basic SEO or blog writing

Experience creating testimonial or case study content

Experience managing Google reviews and online reputation



Beyond skills: we want someone who genuinely wants to understand and reach the people Prescare serves through meaningful content. Families making care decisions, and nurses evaluating employers. If you can bring that human understanding to your work, we want to hear from you.



This is a remote independent contractor role. The successful candidate is responsible for their own equipment, internet connection, taxes, and local compliance requirements.



What we offer

Opportunity to grow into a full-time Marketing Coordinator or Client Engagement Lead role

Weekly check-ins and mentorship from leadership

Support with digital tools and content templates

A mission-driven, inclusive team culture

Competitive hourly rate: CAD $8–$14/hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio. Candidates with strong Canva, reels, Google Business Profile, and GoHighLevel experience may be considered at the higher end of the range.

description:

, WhatsApp, signup forms) across e-commerce client accounts in the DACH region.

 

About us

The Marketing Collective is a boutique done-for-you retention marketing agency for German-speaking e-commerce brands. We run Klaviyo
 programs, WhatsApp campaigns (Chatarmin/Charles), and data-driven segmentation across multiple client accounts.

 

Every brand is served by a three-person pod: the Brand Manager writes the copy, the Designer designs the
, and you execute, QA, and ship it in Klaviyo. You are the final gate before anything reaches a customer. When it works, no one thinks about it. When it breaks, everyone does. That is why diligence and a love for detail matter more in this role than anywhere else.

 

What you'll do

 

Execution (the majority of the work)

- Set up campaigns in Klaviyo: segments and exclusions, UTM tracking, Smart Sending, promo code verification, campaign tagging

- Run our full 18-item pre-send QA checklist (links, buttons, mobile, dark mode, dynamic variables, file size, segments, send time) and schedule the send

- Build flows: triggers, flow and profile filters, conditional/trigger splits; QA with our checklist, set live, and review 24-48h after launch

- Implement, QA, and schedule WhatsApp campaigns in Chatarmin/Charles

- Own the technical setup and go-live of signup forms: end-to-end submission testing, GDPR/CAN-SPAM compliance (the Designer owns the visual build)

- Set up A/B tests, check functionality, document results

- Clone, QA, and schedule translated campaign versions

- Light
 design in Klaviyo with our modular templates when needed (you do not own design)

 

Strategy and maintenance

- Create flow briefings that fully inform the Brand Manager (copy) and Designer (visual direction)

- Develop segmentation strategies along our frameworks (VIP, engagement, lifecycle, product affinity), e.g. for BFCM

- Analyze performance in Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and BI tools; make data-driven recommendations

- Weekly Klaviyo monitor checks and monthly health checks for every client: deliverability, list hygiene, suppression, integration errors

 

Coordination

- Daily ClickUp check-ins; Slack communication with the team and in client channels

- Give the Designer feedback on asset quality; create and update SOPs

 

The standard we hold

- 100% pre-send QA completion: the checklist runs in full, every time, no exceptions

- Zero critical QA misses per month (broken links, wrong promo codes, missing unsubscribe link, wrong segment, broken mobile rendering, blank dynamic variables)

- 95%+ on-time sends

- When a mistake happens, you own it, document the root cause, and facilitate a process update so it does not happen twice

 

What you bring

- 2-3+ years in digital marketing, ideally e-commerce

- 1-2+ years hands-on Klaviyo: building flows, running campaigns, managing multiple accounts

- Extreme attention to detail with excellent follow-through - the single most important trait for this role

- Strong technical judgement in Klaviyo: flow logic, Smart Sending vs Smart Send Time, deliverability, segmentation

- Comfortable working in German-language accounts and QA-ing translated copy against the copy doc (native German NOT required; we work with AI tools and client confirmation)

- Well-versed in GDPR and CAN-SPAM

- Proactive and self-managed: you run a portfolio of accounts with minimal supervision (you start at 2-3 accounts and ramp to 8-10)

- Full-time availability (40 hrs/week) with working-hour overlap with European (CET) business hours

 

Nice to have

- Chatarmin/Charles, Shopify, Google Analytics

- Figma or Canva for light
 design

- AI tools for QA, briefings, and translation

- KnoCommerce, Decify, Typeform (surveys); Sendtric (countdown timers)

 

Why work with us

- Long-term role: our tea
mbers have been with us for years

- Clear growth path from technical execution to strategic ownership (segment definitions, flow logic, account-level calls)

- Supportive remote team with clear systems and SOPs, experienced and empathetic leadership

- No hustle culture: if you are good at your job, 8 hours a day, 5 days a week is enough to do exceptional work - and we hire ahead so it stays that way

 

Project details

- Contract: Full-time, long-term (40 hrs/week)

- Experience level: Intermediate to Expert

- Remote: Yes

- Start: ASAP

 

How to apply (required)

Growth: propose ideas to grow subscribers (formats, timing, collabs, repurposing). You propose, I approve, you execute. No engagement pods, no automation, no spam tactics, ever.

Excellent attention to detail — this job is following checklists perfectly

Reliable internet, own computer, consistent long-term availability

About me as an employer: I ran a company with a team for a decade. Clear instructions, documented processes, on-time pay, respect for your time, and a long-term seat if you're excellent. I promote from within my own systems — this role grows as the publication grows.

(3) If you've helped grow an audience, name two tactics that actually worked. (4) Your expected monthly salary for ~10-15 hrs/month.

title: Executive assistant/Chief of staff
description:
Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant / Chief of staff — Inbox, Systems & Focus Management for a Busy Founder



Type: Full-time, remote (Philippines)

AEST

Start: ASAP



About the role



I'm a founder who moves fast and juggles a lot — Lots of
s a day, several live projects, and a habit of jumping between ideas before finishing them. I'm looking for an experienced EA/PA who's done this before and can walk in with real systems, not someone I need to train from scratch.



Your core job is to give me long, uninterrupted blocks of focused work time by owning everything that would otherwise pull my attention — my inbox, my task follow-through, and the systems that keep my work organized. You'll triage what's urgent, file what isn't, chase down the things I start and abandon, and build the structure that makes my day-to-day run without me having to hold it all in my head.



This is not a "wait for instructions" role. I want someone who sees a mess and already knows three ways to fix it, then tells me which one they recommend.



What you'll actually do



Inbox and communications management





Triage 50+
s a day: flag what's truly urgent, draft or send replies to routine ones, file or archive the rest.

Build (or bring) a labeling/folder system so nothing important gets buried and I never have to "dig."

Give me a short daily summary of what needs my attention 

Protect my focus blocks: nothing reaches me during deep work unless it's genuinely time-sensitive.





Task and project follow-through





When I start something and go quiet on it — say I
 one manufacturer about a deal and then get pulled away — you catch it, log it, and keep it moving. Follow up, gather next steps, and bring it back to me at the right 
nt instead of letting it die in my inbox.

Keep a live tracker of everything "in motion" so nothing I care about falls through the cracks.

Help me plan my 1–3 big tasks for the day and hold the line on protecting time for them.





Systems and organization





Assess how I currently work and propose better systems — task management, file organization, information storage — so I stop repeating myself and you (or I) can always find what's needed in seconds.

Build and maintain SOPs/templates for recurring work so things run consistently even when I'm not involved.

Own the "single source of truth" for my ongoing projects, contacts, and open loops.





Growth into broader support (bonus, not day-one requirement)





Light outreach: researching and contacting potential customers, suppliers, manufacturers, or distributors on my behalf.

Picking up a thread I've started (e.g., "find an Australian manufacturer for X") and running it to completion or a clear next decision point.

Other ad hoc research and admin as trust builds.



Meta ads management is a big bonus



Who I'm looking for





2+ years of experience as an EA, PA, or Chief of Staff-type role, ideally supporting a founder, executive, or otherwise fast-moving/scattered client.

You've dealt with a high-volume inbox before and have your own method for taming it — you can describe it in the interview without prompting.

You're a systems thinker: you default to "let's build a process for this" rather than solving the same problem manually every time.

Comfortable managing ambiguity and half-finished threads — you can take a vague or dropped task and turn it into a completed one.

Strong written English and excellent follow-up discipline — things don't slip through with you.

Proactive: you bring me options and recommendations, not just questions. I don't want to micromanage; I want to hand you a problem and trust you'll either solve it or tell me clearly what you need fro
.

Bonus: experience with
 outreach, lead generation, or light sales/vendor research.

Bonus: experience working with founders or clients who are ADHD/high-context-switching — you understand why protecting focus time matters and won't take it personally when I'm heads-down.





Tools you should be comfortable with (or learn fast)



Gmail/Google Workspace, a task manager (Asana/ClickUp/Notion/Trello — tell me what you prefer and why), and general cloud file organization (Google Drive). Familiarity with automation tools (Zapier, etc.) is a plus but not required. AI savvy, Meta Ads



How to apply



Please include:





A short note on how you currently structure your day/inbox management system for a busy client — give me a real example.

A specific example of a time you caught a "dropped" task or project and got it back on track without being asked.

Your relevant experience (years, type of clients/executives supported) and availability (hours/timezone overlap).

Your expected monthly salary.





Applications without a real example of your system (not just "I'm organized and detail-oriented") will not be considered — I want to see how you think, not a generic pitch.

title: Meta ads Video editor
description:
POSIZIONE APERTA  ·  FREELANCE  ·  FULL REMOTE



Video Editor – Performance Marketing

E-commerce · Meta Ads · Short-form Video · Alto Volume

Il contesto

Vendiamo un prodotto fisico tramite Meta Ads e Shopify. Il video è il nostro asset principale — non un supporto, è il core del business. Ogni giorno senza nuovi video da testare è un giorno di dati persi e soldi lasciati sul tavolo.

Stiamo cercando un video editor che capisca cosa significa lavorare in un contesto di performance marketing: velocità di esecuzione, volume costante, capacità di iterare rapidamente sui formati che funzionano. Non stiamo producendo cortometraggi. Stiamo producendo macchine da conversione.

Cosa farai

Montare video ad per Meta (Feed, Reels, Stories) partendo da raw footage UGC, screen recording, asset grafici e hook forniti dal team

Produrre più varianti dello stesso concetto per i test A/B — stesso messaggio, esecuzioni diverse

Iterare velocemente sui formati che performano meglio: più varianti, più angoli, più hook

Proporre autonomamente nuove direzioni creative basandoti su ciò che vedi funzionare nel nostro settore

Rispettare le deadline senza promemoria: se dici che consegni giovedì, consegni giovedì



??  Attenzione: Se hai bisogno di brief dettagliatissimi, approvazioni continue e due settimane per consegnare un video da 30 secondi, questo ruolo non fa per te. Nessun giudizio — semplicemente non è l’ambiente giusto.

Il profilo che stiamo cercando

Hai già lavorato su video per Meta Ads o contenuti e-commerce orientati alla conversione (non solo video corporate o eventi)

Sai cos'è un hook visivo, un pattern interrupt, una CTA efficace — e li applichi senza che te lo debbano spiegare ogni volta

Lavori veloce: non “abbastanza veloce”, veloce davvero. Riesci a consegnare 3–5 video alla settimana mantenendo qualità

Sei proattivo: mandi idee, proponi varianti, segnali quando qualcosa non sta funzionando visivamente

Conosci le specifiche tecniche di Meta — aspect ratio, durata, safe zone, audio off — senza dover essere guidato

Tool e formato di lavoro

CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci o qualunque tool usi per lavorare bene e veloce — non abbiamo preferenze purché il risultato sia consegnabile nei formati richiesti. Collaborazione 100% remota, comunicazione via WhatsApp/Slack, materiali condivisi su Google Drive.

Compenso

fino a $1.500/mese  —  Collaborazione freelance · Fattura mensile

Come candidarsi

Mandaci un messaggio con:

Il link al tuo portfolio (o Drive/Notion con esempi di lavoro) — obbligatorio, senza non valutiamo

2–3 righe su quale risultato concreto hai generato con i video che hai prodotto (ROAS, CTR, conversioni — qualcosa di misurabile)

La tua disponibilità e con quanti progetti puoi gestire in parallelo



Non servono lettere di presentazione formali. Bastano portfolio + risultati + disponibilità. Chi si candida con un messaggio generico senza portfolio non riceverà risposta — non per mancanza di rispetto, ma perché è il primo segnale di come lavorerebbe.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor for Scaling 7-Figure Ecommerce Brand
description:
Video Editor (AI UGC + VSL) — 7-Figure Ecom Brand



We're a 7-figure DTC brand spending significant daily budget on Meta. We need a fast, sharp video editor to produce ad creatives we test and scale across
 and Instagram. This isn't a "make it pretty" role — your job is making content that stops the scroll.



A huge part of this role is generating AI UGC at scale. **You must be specialized in Seedance and Kling 3.0 inside HiggsField** — this is non-negotiable, and we will test it.



What You'll Be Doing



- **Generate AI UGC videos** using Seedance and Kling 3.0 on HiggsField with strategic image + video prompting — realistic, conversion-focused content that's indistinguishable from real creator footage

- **Edit VSLs (Video Sales Letters)** — long-form sales videos with captions, b-roll overlays, product demos, and pacing that holds attention from hook to CTA

- **Cut ad creatives** — UGC mashups, statics-to-video, testimonial edits, and comparison-style ads

- **Produce hook variations fast** — take one winning body and ship 5–10 new hooks (first 3 seconds) for testing

- **Handle the full edit stack** — captions, pacing, sound design, b-roll, transitions, and native-feeling 9:16 vertical output



Must-Haves



- **Proven hands-on experience with Seedance and Kling 3.0 on HiggsField** — you know how to prompt for realism (consistent characters, natural motion, no AI artifacts), not just generate slop

- VSL editing experience — you've cut long-form sales videos before, not just short clips

- Fast turnaround: multiple creative variations per day, not per week

- Fluent English comprehension — you'll work from scripts and need to match cuts to copy beats

- Portfolio of actual ad creatives and at least one VSL (not wedding videos, not cinematic reels)



Nice-to-Haves



- Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools

- Nano Banana or other AI image generation for start frames

- Basic motion graphics (product callouts, text animations)

- Familiarity with Meta ad compliance (health/beauty claims, before-afters, etc.)



What You Get



- Long-term role with a scaling brand — consistent volume, not one-off gigs

- Direct feedback on how your ads actually perform

- Room to grow as we scale



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **"SCROLL-STOPPER"** so we know you read this

2. Send 2–3 AI UGC examples made with Seedance or Kling 3.0 — tell us which model and roughly how you prompted it

3. Send 1 VSL you've edited (link, not attachment)

4. Send 2–3 of your best ad creatives



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Music  AI Song Specialist Needed for YouTube Videos.
description:
We are looking for someone experienced in creating **copyright-safe music for YouTube videos**.



We already have our own AI video production team. We do **not** need help creating the video scenes. We need help with the **music side**: lyrics, melody, vocals, arrangement, recording rights, synchronization rights, and YouTube Content ID safety.



Our first project is a **Red River Valley–style music video**. We want to know the safest way to use or rebuild this song for YouTube, without copying a copyrighted recording, singer, arrangement, backing track, or modern version.



**Main Responsibilities**



Help us determine whether a song is public domain, copyrighted, or partly protected.



Explain what parts of a song may still be protected, including lyrics, melody, arrangement, recording, vocal performance, backing track, and artist style.



Help create a copyright-safe version of a song using original or properly licensed music.



Help rebuild the music track in a safe way, including new arrangement, new vocals, new instruments, and safe licensing.



Advise us on YouTube Content ID risks before we publish.



Help us understand what we can legally use in a YouTube music video.



Help us avoid copying any existing artist, channel, recording, or performance.



**Skills Required**



Strong understanding of music copyright for YouTube.



Experience with public-domain songs, cover songs, licensing, synchronization rights, master recording rights, and Content ID claims.



Experience creating or rebuilding music using tools such as Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs, Kits.ai, Synthesizer V, Ace Studio, Logic Pro, Ableton, FL Studio, GarageBand, or similar tools.



Ability to create or manage new vocals, new backing tracks, and new arrangements.



Ability to explain copyright risks in simple English.



Experience with YouTube music publishing is a strong advantage.



**Important**



We are not looking for someone to copy music from another YouTube channel.



We are not looking for someone to remove copyright claims from stolen music.



We are not looking for someone to imitate a famous singer’s voice.



We are looking for a safe, legal, practical way to create music for our own AI-made videos.



**First Test Project**



Help us create a copyright-safe plan for a **Red River Valley–style song**.



The plan should explain:



Whether the lyrics are safe to use

Whether the melody is safe to use

How to create a new arrangement

How to create or license the vocal

How to create a safe backing track

How to avoid copying modern recordings

How to reduce YouTube Content ID risks

What final music files we need for video editing



**Please Apply With**



Your experience with music copyright or YouTube music publishing.



Examples of songs, covers, backing tracks, or AI music projects you have worked on.



The music tools you use.



A short explanation of how you would make Red River Valley safe for YouTube.



Your hourly rate or project price.



We already handle AI video creation. We only need help with the music, copyright, licensing, and safe YouTube publishing side.

title: B2B Outreach & Lead Generation Specialist (Rock & Mineral Industry)
description:

By operating our own production facilities, we eliminate the middleman, allowing us to provide unmatched volume, premium quality, and highly competitive pricing to the global market.



As we expand our footprint, we are looking for a relentless, data-driven Outreach Specialist to connect our supply chain directly with retail and online buyers.

Cold Outreach Execution: Multi-channel outreach 
, phone, and professional social channels) to pitch our wholesale catalog and direct-from-source advantages.

The "Genius" Factor: You don't just send generic templates; you know how to find the real decision-maker, understand their pain points (supply consistency, margins), and pitch strategically.

Resilience & Autonomy: You are self-motivated, organized, and thrive on turning cold data into warm business opportunities.



Flawless Communication: Strong written and spoken English skills.



What We Offer:

Competitive Base Salary to secure your dedicated time and expertise.



Uncapped Commission Structure: Earn a percentage on every single order placed by the leads you generate.



Unbeatable Product Value: You will be pitching direct factory pricing on highly sought-after material, giving you a massive competitive edge in the market.



Growth Potential: Opportunity to scale with us as we expand into new product lines and international markets.



How to Apply

If you have a proven track record of hitting outreach targets and want to leverage a bulletproof supply chain to clear massive commissions, we want to hear from you.

A brief summary of your B2B outreach experience.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – Meta Paid Ads (Performance)
description:
This is not a polish-and-export job. Your job is to take a folder of raw footage — UGC, product shots, lifestyle clips — and turn it into a short-form ad that stops the scroll, holds attention, and makes someone want to buy.

We're a DTC leather goods brand running ads on
 and Instagram. We test a lot of creative, so you'll be cutting short-form vertical ads from briefs, often making several versions of the same concept to see what converts.



What we're looking for:



- A track record of high-performing Meta ads. You've edited short-form ads that have actually run on
/Instagram and driven results — not just videos that looked good, but videos that performed. Be ready to show us.



- Editing that tells a story and hooks the viewer. You know how to grab attention in the first 1–2 seconds and hold it all the way through, using pacing, structure, and cuts to keep someone watching instead of scrolling past.



- Showcasing the product. By the end of the ad, the viewer clearly understands what the product is, why it's worth having, and why they want it — the edit sells without feeling like a hard sell.



- The ability to work with any footage. Give you a messy, wide-ranging folder of raw clips and you can shape it into a clean, successful ad. Turning chaos into a story that converts is the core of this role.



- Know the editing requirements needed to produce engaging ads AND that display well on social media, think formats, clean captions (not spammy), good audio etc



What matters most: storytelling and performance, not technical polish. We'd take a rough cut that converts over a beautiful one that falls flat. Captions, sound design, and clean transitions matter, but they come after the story works.

You'll work from briefs and iterate quickly on feedback, so being responsive and organised is as important as your editing.



Requirements: proven short-for
ta ad editing (please link examples — not vlogs, weddings, or corporate videos), comfortable with fast iteration, and able to work hours overlapping our South African timezone. Daily AI-tool use in your workflow is a plus.



How to Apply: 

Fill out the Google Form with your details AND complete the free trial task so we can access your abilities to edit videos that can hook and tell a story while selling the product.

**Application Code: SYSTEMS CREATE FREEDOM**



UnityEd is a growing education company creating professional resources, digital products, online courses, and systems of support for educators, schools, professionals, and families navigating special education.



We are growing quickly and are looking for an exceptional **Systems & Operations Manager / Executive Virtual Assistant** to help manage our day-to-day operations, team workflows, projects, deadlines, and backend business systems.

We are not looking for someone who waits for daily instructions, simply checks off tasks, or creates more work for the founder to manage.



We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done, creates order, follows through, solves problems, communicates proactively, and takes genuine ownership of their responsibilities.

mbers into a well-organized, efficient operation.



---

---

mbers regarding deadlines and incomplete assignments.

mbers.

mbers.

* Complete backend business and administrative tasks independently.

* Help create systems that allow the company to operate more efficiently.



# **THIS IS A PLAYER-COACH POSITION**



We are specifically looking for someone who can both **manage and execute**.



Approximately:



**60% Operations, Project Management & Team Coordination**



**40% Direct Execution & Administrative Support**



This is not a position where you simply assign work to other people.



You must be willing to personally complete operational, organizational, administrative, documentation, tracking, and quality-control tasks.



---



# **WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely organized.

* Proactive.

* Resourceful.

* Detail-oriented.

* Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.

* Able to work independently.

* A strong written communicator.

* Comfortable following up with tea
mbers.

* Comfortable learning new technology.

# **EXPERIENCE WE VALUE**

# **COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS**

* Communicate delays or problems immediately.

* Ask thoughtful questions when clarification is genuinely needed.

mbers.

mbers, contractors, or projects have you managed simultaneously? What exactly were you responsible for?**

 when to solve a problem independently versus asking the founder for help?**

 Ads Library, TikTok Creative Center or other software tools) to spot hooks/angles worth testing

title: Executive assistant
description:
I'm a founder who moves fast and juggles a lot — around 100
s a day, several live projects, and a habit of jumping between ideas before finishing them. I'm looking for an experienced EA/PA who's done this before and can walk in with real systems, not someone I need to train from scratch.



Your core job is to give me long, uninterrupted blocks of focused work time by owning everything that would otherwise pull my attention — my inbox, my task follow-through, and the systems that keep my work organized. You'll triage what's urgent, file what isn't, chase down the things I start and abandon, and build the structure that makes my day-to-day run without me having to hold it all in my head.



This is not a "wait for instructions" role. I want someone who sees a mess and already knows three ways to fix it, then tells me which one they recommend.



What you'll actually do



Inbox and communications management





Triage 100+
s a day: flag what's truly urgent, draft or send replies to routine ones, file or archive the rest.

Build (or bring) a labeling/folder system so nothing important gets buried and I never have to "dig."

Give me a short daily summary of what needs my attention — not a raw inbox dump.

Protect my focus blocks: nothing reaches me during deep work unless it's genuinely time-sensitive.





Task and project follow-through





When I start something and go quiet on it — say I
 one manufacturer about a deal and then get pulled away — you catch it, log it, and keep it moving. Follow up, gather next steps, and bring it back to me at the right 
nt instead of letting it die in my inbox.

Keep a live tracker of everything "in motion" so nothing I care about falls through the cracks.

Help me plan my 1–3 big tasks for the day and hold the line on protecting time for them.





Systems and organization





Assess how I currently work and propose better systems — task management, file organization, information storage — so I stop repeating myself and you (or I) can always find what's needed in seconds.

Build and maintain SOPs/templates for recurring work so things run consistently even when I'm not involved.

Own the "single source of truth" for my ongoing projects, contacts, and open loops.





Growth into broader support (bonus, not day-one requirement)





Light outreach: researching and contacting potential customers, suppliers, manufacturers, or distributors on my behalf.

Picking up a thread I've started (e.g., "find an Australian manufacturer for X") and running it to completion or a clear next decision point.

Other ad hoc research and admin as trust builds.





Who I'm looking for





2+ years of experience as an EA, PA, or Chief of Staff-type role, ideally supporting a founder, executive, or otherwise fast-moving/scattered client.

You've dealt with a high-volume inbox before and have your own method for taming it — you can describe it in the interview without prompting.

You're a systems thinker: you default to "let's build a process for this" rather than solving the same problem manually every time.

Comfortable managing ambiguity and half-finished threads — you can take a vague or dropped task and turn it into a completed one.

Strong written English and excellent follow-up discipline — things don't slip through with you.

Proactive: you bring me options and recommendations, not just questions. I don't want to micromanage; I want to hand you a problem and trust you'll either solve it or tell me clearly what you need fro
.

Bonus: experience with
 outreach, lead generation, or light sales/vendor research.

Bonus: experience working with founders or clients who are ADHD/high-context-switching — you understand why protecting focus time matters and won't take it personally when I'm heads-down.





Tools you should be comfortable with (or learn fast)



Gmail/Google Workspace, a task manager (Asana/ClickUp/Notion/Trello — tell me what you prefer and why), and general cloud file organization (Google Drive). Familiarity with automation tools (Zapier, etc.) is a plus but not required.



How to apply



Please include:





A short note on how you currently structure your day/inbox management system for a busy client — give me a real example.

A specific example of a time you caught a "dropped" task or project and got it back on track without being asked.

Your relevant experience (years, type of clients/executives supported) and availability (hours/timezone overlap).

Your expected monthly salary.





Applications without a real example of your system (not just "I'm organized and detail-oriented") will not be considered — I want to see how you think, not a generic pitch.

We are looking to hire a highly skilled Digital PR writer who can write organic, informative, and thoughtful copy with a short turnaround time for any of the following topics on a long-term basis:



-Real estate and property management

-Precious metals, gems, and jewelry

-Business management, administration, leadership, and marketing

-Promotional products, events, and brand activation

-Home maintenance, pest control, insects/bugs, and extermination

-Home entertainment, audio/video, home theatre, film, music

-Health, medicine, pain management, wellness, pharmacology, and similar

-Other topics (please mention specialized backgrounds, experience, qualification you may have in other fields)



Pay and Benefits: Payment is either hourly or by piece/word count, please share your preference(s) and what you’re open to. We’re looking for someone who can work around 20 hours per week, and the base hourly rate is $6. Stronger candidates may be offered more. After a successful first year of consistent positive performance, you will be provided a 13th month Holiday Bonus which will be an average of all your months’ total pays.





Please read through areas A through and, in your application, include answers and confirmation for each area.



A) Confirm you meet these Requirements/Focus Areas:



1. Strong English at native written level or higher. Writer should be able to adjust written style between various formalities, tones, and for different audiences.

2. Zero use or dependency with AI. We provide clients with an AI-free experience and therefore cannot compensate any writer for any AI-generated content, text, or phrase. We use a proprietary AI-detection protocol that all submitted work is subject to. If you dislike what AI is doing to our industry, you’ll likely be a good fit for this role!

3. Ability to write under time constraints. Many of our PR opportunities have fast and hard deadlines.

4. Reliable communication. Writers have to coordinate and keep in touch with the team. A lack of communication on a daily basis would not be a good fit for this role.



B) Confirm you can meet this Role Schedule: Write daily online Monday-Thursday with at least one hour available from 9am-5pm Eastern Time for team check-in and communication. Fridays are optional and other work hours are flexible per your preference/needs.



C) Confirm acceptance of these Performance Benchmarks:

1. Weekly written volume (words, memos written, etc)

2. Placement rate (how much of your work results in a placement for a client)

3. Communication regularity and promptness

4. Writing speed (how responsive are you once opportunities are live)



D) State PR platforms you’re familiar with and how much experience you have (if any): ?Examples: HARO, Qwoted, SOS, Featured, Connectively, Source Bottle, etc



E) Summarize your philosophy as you approach this kind of work (which standards are most important to uphold, what makes you happy/unhappy in a job like this, what kind of volume/output/team environment do you thrive in, where do you see the future of this work going?)



F) Confirm you are willing to abide by a strict No-AI policy for all submitted copy and that you are willing to do your best to help us ensure our output is as organic and AI-proof as possible. Our entire team’s success, at every level, depends on integrity and transparency in order to survive.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Job Title: AI Video Editor – Storytelling Videos for TikTok (Script-to-Video)



About the Role

I run a TikTok affiliate account in Germany. I need someone to turn my scripts into finished AI-generated storytelling videos. Each video tells a story with a product reveal. I provide the script and mostly a reference Video. You produce the video in this style with your generated clips.



This is short-form content (TikTok, 9:16). German voiceover. Starts with a paid trial task – if quality is right, this becomes ongoing work.



Reference style – watch these first:





This is the exact style and quality level I want. Story-driven, AI-generated visuals, clean editing, product appears.



Workflow per video

1. I send you a script or a Video (english or german) + product info

2. You generate AI video clips matching the story (use any tool that gets the result: Veo 3, Kling, Runway, Hailuo, Freepik, etc.)

3. You generate the German script & voiceover in ElevenLabs

4. You edit everything in CapCut: cuts, transitions, sound effects, bg music

5. You deliver the final MP4, 9:16, ready to post



Requirements

- Real hands-on experience with AI video tools – you understand prompting, character consistency, how to fix common AI issues

- CapCut skills: timing, pacing, captions, sound design

- ElevenLabs or similar voiceover experience

- You can match a reference style

- Decent written English (we communicate in English)

- German is NOT required – the script and voiceover are in German, but you don't need to speak it. You just need to follow the script timing and sync captions correctly.



Pay

$3 per finished video. Weekly payout via PayPal.

Test batch first. Volume scales up if quality and speed are good.



How to apply

contact me on Whatsapp 
and send:

1. Short intro about you + your AI video experience

2. 2-3 examples of AI videos or short-form edits you've made (links)

3. Which AI video tools you've actually used

4. Turnaround time per video (script + Video received -- final delivery)





Applications without examples or without answering questions will be ignored.



Looking forward to your application.

title: Bookkeeper & accountant working with Xero, Kajabi, Stripe, PayPal, & Wells Fargo
description:

We use Xero as our financial software, so the core of your work will be with Xero. To qualify for this position, you will need experience with Xero.



Our Xero interacts with other services including Kajabi, PayPal, Stripe, Xero, and Wells Fargo, so you will need experience with those services, too. 



Your responsibilities will include:

What do we need from our Xero accountant?

Reconcile transactions in Xero, done every week 

Create clear documentation, in text and in screen recordings, of how to sort transactions across categories (what transactions belong to what categories, and how you can tell)

Prepare selected reports, starting with how much we're spending yearly & monthly on recurring subscription services

Prepare financial projections of our expenditures

Prepare Profit & Loss statements and income statements

The team would make better decisions about product launches, and timelines for product rollout, and product features (for example, the pricing and number of spots in our courses) if we had access to the right financial information at the right times. You will be responsible for talking with the team and figuring out what information they need and when, and what financial reports will represent that info. Then create a schedule to present financial reports to the team at the right times (probably 2-4x/year).

Familiarize yourself with the system and be available to answer our questions or show us how data is categorized in Xero

mbers on the East Coast of the US and in Europe, so we would need you to work at a time that's amenable to people in the US (East Coast) and Europe. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. The company is investing in your next step.





How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule

You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start

Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy

HMO

title: QA Notes Reviewer – Home Health (Medicare)
description:
Job Title: QA Notes Reviewer – Home Health (Medicare)

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time

Monthly Salary: USD $700

Job Summary

The QA Notes Reviewer is responsible for reviewing and auditing clinical documentation for a Medicare-certified home health agency. This position ensures that nursing, therapy (PT, OT, ST), Medical Social Worker (MSW), and Home Health Aide (HHA) documentation is accurate, complete, and compliant with Medicare regulations, physician orders, and agency policies.

Responsibilities

• Review Skilled Nursing (SN) visit notes for accuracy and Medicare compliance.

• Review Physical Therapy (PT), Occupational Therapy (OT), and Speech Therapy (ST) documentation.

• Review Medical Social Worker (MSW) and Home Health Aide (HHA) visit notes.

• Ensure documentation supports medical necessity and homebound status.

• Verify notes are consistent with the Plan of Care (POC) and physician orders.

• Check visit frequencies, interventions, goals, and patient responses.

• Identify missing documentation, physician orders, signatures, and dates.

• Communicate documentation deficiencies to clinicians for correction.

• Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

• Meet daily productivity and quality standards.

Qualifications

• Registered Nurse (RN) preferred or equivalent home health experience.

• Minimum of 2 years of U.S. Medicare Home Health experience.

• Knowledge of Medicare regulations, OASIS, and home health documentation.

• Experience reviewing nursing and therapy documentation.

• Strong attention to detail and excellent English communication skills.

• Experience using EMR systems.

• Ability to work independently in a remote setting.

Work Schedule

• Remote (Philippines)

• Full-time

• Must be available to work U.S. business hours.

Compensation & Benefits

• Monthly Salary: USD $700

title: Medical Virtual Assistant + Executive Assistant — US Cardiology Practice
description:
About Us



We are a physician-owned cardiology (heart rhythm) specialty practice in Los Angeles, California, launching a new clinic. You will work directly with the physician-owner — no layers, no agency, no middleman. This is a long-term role with growth potential as the practice grows. We use modern tools (AI-assisted workflows, cloud systems) and we invest in training the right person.



The Role



This is a hybrid role: roughly 80% medical back-office work, 20% executive assistant work. You will become the physician's right hand.



Medical back-office (primary):

- Prior authorizations for procedures, imaging, and medications (US payers: Medicare, Anthem, UnitedHealthcare, etc.)

- Insurance eligibility and benefits verification

- Chart preparation before patient visits (records review, organizing documents in the EMR)

- Indexing incoming faxes, labs, and outside records into patient charts

- Referral coordination and tracking (incoming and outgoing)

- Patient recall, scheduling support, and follow-up tracking

- Speaking with patients by phone: appointment coordination, reminders, follow-up calls, and gathering information before visits

- Spreadsheet work: building and maintaining tracking spreadsheets (patient lists, authorization logs, follow-up panels), data entry, cross-checking records between systems, and cleaning up large lists — accuracy over speed. Some of this is tedious and repetitive; we need someone who is just as careful on row 400 as on row 4.



Executive assistant (secondary):

-
 and calendar management

- Document organization, forms, and correspondence

- Tracking tasks and following up until things are DONE

- Personal admin support (travel, appointments, vendor coordination)



Requirements

- 2+ years experience in a US medical practice back-office role (VA or onshore-equivalent work)

- Hands-on experience with prior authorizations and eligibility checks for US insurance

- EMR experience required. eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience is a strong plus. Elation Health experience is a strong plus.

- Excellent written English; clear, confident spoken English — you will speak with patients by phone

- Experience calling patients directly (scheduling, reminders, intake, or follow-up) in a US practice setting

- HIPAA training (certificate preferred; we will provide training and require a signed confidentiality agreement)

- Able to work US Pacific time (Los Angeles) hours: approximately 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PT

- Reliable setup: fast internet (25+ Mbps), backup internet, backup power, quiet workspace, own computer

Nice to Have

- Nursing (RN/USRN) or allied health background

- Cardiology or specialty practice experience

- Experience with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets)

- Medical billing/RCM exposure



What We Offer

- $10/hour, full-time (40 hrs/week), paid weekly or bi-weekly via your preferred method

- Direct mentorship from a US physician; real skill growth in a specialty practice

- Stable, long-term role — we are building a team, not filling a gap
